This charming tabletop Christmas tree brings a warm holiday glow to desks, mantels, and cozy corners while combining 363 mixed PE and PVC branch tips, 50 warm white LED lights, and a stable cement base wrapped in linen fabric for a clean, natural look. Designed for easy seasonal decorating, the battery-operated setup keeps placement flexible, and the built-in timer runs 6 hours on and 18 hours off for effortless daily ambiance. With flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic materials, this small Christmas tree offers a reliable festive accent for homes with children and pets. Its compact 91 cm profile makes it ideal for apartments, offices, living rooms, entryways, and tabletops, while the soft glow creates an inviting Christmas setting without taking up valuable floor space.

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 3 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

5056589155964.sourceDescription:
Make a taller statement this Christmas with the 6ft Light Up Feather Pine Christmas Tree, an illuminated seasonal feature designed for anyone looking for something less conventional than a full artificial tree. This distinctive Christmas tree is a stylish way to introduce height, illumination and a modern festive look to your home.

At 1.8 metres tall, its narrow feather-style branches form a clean, sculptural Christmas tree shape without creating the heavy, densely branched look of a traditional design. This makes it especially effective for entranceways, corners, conservatories and other spaces where height is welcome but floor space is at a premium. 

Woven throughout the tree are 104 warm white LEDs, giving the feathered branches a soft golden glow and creating a welcoming atmosphere once illuminated. The warm lighting works beautifully alongside both classic Christmas décor and more contemporary festive schemes. Made from plastic with a supportive metal frame gives the tree its structure, while the sturdy base keeps the display securely positioned. It is mains powered with a 5m power cable, providing extra reach when arranging your display.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (transformer must remain indoors)

104 Warm White LEDs
Height: 6ft (1.8m) Length approx 110cm Width approx: 70cm

Mains Powered with 5m Power Cable

104 WARM WHITE LEDs: Integrated LEDs illuminate the tree from top to bottom, giving the feather-style branches a warm, inviting glow throughout the festive season.
MODERN FEATHER PINE DESIGN: The open, streamlined branches offer a stylish alternative to the dense foliage of a standard artificial Christmas tree, making it suited to contemporary Christmas displays.
SLIM 22CM FOOTPRINT: Measuring approximately 22cm long by 22cm wide, the tree is particularly useful for corners, hallways, entrances and other areas where available floor space is limited.
MAINS POWERED & STURDY: Constructed from plastic with a supportive metal frame and sturdy base. Includes a generous 5m mains cable and is suitable for indoor and outdoor festive decorating.
Guarantee - 1 year

8941467526264.baseName: 25 Sets 50 Pieces Clear Plastic Fillable Baubles Transparent DIY Christmas Craft Balls 5 Sizes Party Home Decor
8941467526264.variantName: 25 Sets 50 Pieces Clear Plastic Fillable Baubles Transparent DIY Christmas Craft Balls 5 Sizes Party Home Decor
8941467526264.sourceDescription:
This set contains 25 clear plastic baubles in five different sizes, five of each. The diameters are 3 cm (1.18 in), 4 cm (1.57 in), 5 cm (1.97 in), 6 cm (2.36 in) and 7 cm (2.76 in), so you can pick the size that suits the space you are filling or mix them for a layered look across a tree or display.

Each bauble is made from sturdy, durable plastic that is non-toxic and odourless. The material resists chipping and cracking, and the balls can be opened, refilled and used again. The set arrives as 50 hemispheres, and assembling the two halves yourself is part of the craft: each sphere splits into two parts that open and close freely, so filling and emptying are straightforward. A small plastic loop sits at the top of every sphere, ready for ribbon, string or wire, which means the finished bauble can be hung on a tree, in a window or from a hook without extra fittings.

Fill them with ribbons, trinkets, beads or any small decoration, or use them to make DIY soap and bath bo mbs. They suit Christmas trees, shop and hotel displays, window dressing and home decoration, and they can be refilled for a different theme next year.

Working through the five sizes is part of the fun. The smaller spheres hold beads or a few trinkets, while the larger ones take a fuller arrangement of ribbon, string or small ornaments. Once filled, the ball can be changed, emptied and rebuilt without damaging the plastic, so the same 25 pieces can carry a different look each season.

5090061360064.sourceDescription:
Christmas Elf Decoration
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include adjustable design.

Adjustable Design
Adjustment allows the item to be set for the intended arrangement. Choose the position or fit that matches the available space and check it before use.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Jute. Quantity: 3 piece set.
Adjustable design allows flexible positioning for your Christmas display.
Crafted from natural jute material for a festive, rustic aesthetic.
Includes a 3-piece set to create a coordinated holiday focal point.
Versatile hanging ornament suitable for various home decoration styles.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 3 pieces

5056548751664.variantName: Red Ocean Queen Elizabeth II Memorial Plaque Wood Christmas Bauble Tree Decoration Keepsake
5056548751664.sourceDescription:
A beautiful remembrance bauble for her majesty the Queen To remember and honour her long life of service for our country Each one is made with love by the dedicated Red Ocean team paying close attention to detail with high quality print ensuring you the best product to last for many years to come The wonderful range of Red Ocean wooden baubles are perfect to buy for yourself or give as a gift to a family member or loved one each bauble is hand packaged ready to gift Make Christmas all the more special and order your very own keepsake today The message on this bauble reads 2022 The Year We Lost Our Queen The bauble is made from real wood and the design is permanently printed into the wood The wooden bauble is supplied with waxed cotton rope in both black and red colours to allow easy hanging and looks great in any room of the house
A gorgeous hand made memorial gift, combine with a card or suitable on its own, this memorial gift will be great to remember the queen!
JUST A LITTLE GIFT - Whether you are looking for a Memorial Sign or Christmas Bauble! This cute Wooden Memorial Sign is the perfect present for him or her to treasure forever.
Beautiful handmade bauble, crafted individually and printed professionally. The design is unique and made in house, you will only find this great gift from Red Ocean Gifts. We take pride if ensuring you have the best gift to give and to receive
Bauble Size: 80 x 100 mm (8 x 10 cm), gift packed with hanging cord included and made from high grade wood. The precision digital print will last a lifetime and can be hung indoors or outside. Also suitable for sticking or screwing to the wall. Will not fade in the sun. The highest quality to be treasured for years ahead.
Each Red Ocean Gift is Handmade in England by our team of skilled gift makers, who pay attention to every last detail, ensuring that the gift you choose will amaze the recipient. Supplied ready to gift, the Plaque you choose includes it's hanging cord and is finished in protective Red Ocean packaging.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

5056141022864.sourceDescription:
Add a bright finishing touch to your celebration with this 40th birthday confetti in pink and silver. Designed with a metallic foil finish and clear age number shapes, it brings sparkle and colour to party tables without needing complicated setup. The glittering texture helps create a cheerful display for birthdays and other special occasions, while the compact confetti format makes it easy to scatter across table tops, gift areas or buffet displays. Suitable for creating a fun party atmosphere, this decoration is an easy way to personalise a memorable day for family and friends. The pink colourway works well for coordinated birthday styling and adds a lively accent to your event décor.

With four packs included, you have enough confetti to decorate multiple areas or layer the look for added impact. It is ideal for use on indoor celebration tables where you want an eye-catching but simple decorative detail. Whether used alone or alongside other party decorations, the metallic finish and age-themed design help make the occasion feel more festive. A practical choice for birthday parties and anniversary celebrations where you want quick decoration with a polished look.
Foil metallic confetti with a glittering finish that adds colour and sparkle to 40th birthday table decorations.
Clear age number design helps create a themed party display for birthdays and other memorable celebrations.
Pink and silver styling gives an eye-catching look that works well on tables, buffets and gift areas.
Easy to scatter across surfaces for quick decorating without tools, making setup simple before guests arrive.
Four-pack format provides plenty of confetti for layering the effect across more than one area of your party.
Indoor Use
Not resistant to shattering

6313817051764.sourceDescription:
Product features:

 Multicolored orchid garland, outer diameter 40cm, standard door-hanging size; rich color options suitable for decoration in spring and summer seasons.
 Made of artificial floral materials, no need for watering for maintenance, long-lasting and not prone to wilting, can be reused.
 Wide range of applicable scenarios, such as front door wall hanging, entrance hall display window, garden setting, festival decoration, and shooting props.
 The garland frame is flexible, and after being compressed during transportation, it can be manually adjusted to restore the shape, lightweight and easy to hang.


 Product Specifications:

 Material: Plastic
 Quantity: 2/4/6/10 pieces 
 Color: Green
 Size: 40cm


Package contents:
Lilac garland × 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 pieces

 Notes:

 For ease of transportation, the products are shipped in compressed packaging. After receiving the goods, please manually adjust the leaves to achieve a full appearance.
 The new products may have a slight raw material odor. It will dissipate after being placed in a ventilated environment for 1-2 days.
 For long-term storage, please lay them flat and avoid heavy pressure to prevent the branches from deforming. This is a handmade product, and there may be slight differences in the arrangement of the leaves, which is not a quality issue.
 Please note: This product does not include a vase.
Perfect Year-Round Door Wreath: Elevate your front door decor with this summer wreath. Featuring lush artificial faux mums flowers, plastic leaves which can be adapted to any season, It’s a perfect choice for rustic-style accents or window decor.
Waterproof & UV-Resistant: This front door wreath is 100% handmade using high-quality artificial vine and plastic. The vivid faux mums flowers are washable , making it suitable for long-lasting outdoor or indoor decor.
Colorful & Full Lush Texture: This vibrant spring wreath is overflows with lifelike mums floral in a joyful mix of pinks, purples, yellows, reds and whites, set against deep green leaves.full and lush .Its full and lush design makes it a perfect door wreath for outside all season.
PERFECT FOR CELEBRATION: This wreath beautifully transitions from a spring and summer wreath for front door to a festive fall wreath or holiday wreaths for Christmas and Thanksgiving, while also serving as charming wedding decor, farmhouse entryway accent, or year-round home decoration.
THOUGHTFUL GIFT READY TO GIVE: This wreath arrives in a presentation-ready package, making it the perfect surprise gift for housewarmings, Mother's Day, birthdays, or as a beauty to any friend or loved one's home.

Plan the display

5059442204564.baseName: Blue Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 6ft (180cm)
5059442204564.variantName: Blue Spruce Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 6ft (180cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 6ft
5059442204564.sourceDescription:
Bring a living tree into your home for Christmas and enjoy the character that comes with choosing a pot-grown Blue Spruce. Its dense blue-green foliage and naturally conical shape create a full, well-balanced tree, while the slightly more rigid needles help the branches hold their shape beneath heavy lights and decorations. The unusual colouring sets it apart from other varieties, giving this real Christmas tree a distinctive appearance without needing to overdo the decorations.
DISTINCTIVE BLUE SPRUCE: Blue-green foliage and dense branching give this tree its characteristic appearance, with a naturally conical shape that looks full and well balanced. It also makes an attractive outdoor Christmas tree once the festive season has finished.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
NEEDLES THAT HOLD WELL: Blue Spruce is known for its good needle retention, helping it maintain a full, fresh appearance throughout the Christmas period. This makes it a practical option for enjoying a real tree indoors without the rapid needle drop associated with some varieties.
YEAR-ROUND EVERGREEN TREES FOR GARDEN STRUCTURE: Blue Spruce keeps its blue-green foliage throughout the year, so its interest doesn't end when the Christmas decorations come down. Its evergreen character can add structure and colour to an outdoor space through every season.
CARE FOR YOUR LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Keep the compost moist while the tree is indoors, but avoid leaving it sitting in excess water. Position it away from radiators, fires, and other direct sources of heat, and keep its time indoors to the festive period rather than treating it like a permanent houseplant.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

5056709903864.sourceDescription:
EVRE Canada Spruce is our premium 5ft (150 cm) artificial Christmas tree, styled on a Canadian spruce with 500 pine-needle tips and a heavyweight 4.6 kg build for a full, natural silhouette that stands solid once decorated. Hinged branches drop into place as the two sections slot together, and it suits living rooms, dining rooms and compact family spaces. It comes apart after Christmas to store and use again year after year.
Premium 5ft (150 cm) Canada Spruce with 500 pine-needle tips for dense, natural-looking branches with plenty of room for decorations.
Heavyweight 4.6 kg build with a foldable metal stand (35 x 35 x 19 cm) and protective floor caps, so it stands steady once fully decorated.
Quick to put up: hinged branches drop into place as you slot the two sections together. Unlit, so you choose your own lights and decorations.
Decorating guide: we suggest around 500 lights (about 100 per foot of tree), plus baubles and garland to suit your style.
Shaping: peel back each branch and spread the tips from the inside out. Allow up to 30 minutes for the fullest finish.
Comes apart for storage at the end of the season and can be reused year after year.
Safety: keep away from fires, heaters and naked flames, use lights designed for Christmas trees, and supervise children and pets near the tree.
Available in 4ft 5ft 6ft 7ft 8ft and 9ft
